scope: §6dz: Producer-Pass Coalescing Isolation on Apple M5
hypothesis: Isolate the effect of coalescing the three indirect producer dispatches (cpS1, cpS2, cpFallback) into a single WGPUComputePassEncoder, keeping all pipelines, bind groups, indirect offsets, and shaders identical byte-for-byte.

findings_summary.dispatch_latency_impact_repeat_1: Neutral within +/-0.19% across two independent invocations
findings_summary.conclusion: Command-encoder boundary overhead is negligible on Apple M5 (~1-2 µs per pass). The hardware bottleneck remains kernel compute/memory traffic (per-ray interval arithmetic, stack frame spill, and branch divergence), not command-buffer pass transitions.
